projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard platform that ingests customer CSV files, analyzes application logs, and presents interactive visualizations. Major workstreams: (1) data processing pipeline for customer CSV ingestion, (2) log analysis from application logs, (3) visualization components and dashboard UI.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: TRACKING EPIC (container, not directly executed). The 8/10 score reflects total milestone effort, not a single work item. Execution happens through its 4 child tasks (all complexity ≤4): CSV upload endpoint & file intake → CSV schema validation & error reporting → Data cleansing & normalization → Load cleansed data into analytics store. Milestone is complete when all children are done.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: TRACKING EPIC (container, not directly executed). The 8/10 score reflects total milestone effort, not a single work item. Execution happens through its 4 child tasks (all complexity ≤5): Log ingestion from application log sources → Log parsing & structured extraction → Log aggregation & metrics computation → Error & anomaly detection rules. Milestone is complete when all children are done.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Visualization & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: TRACKING EPIC (container, not directly executed). The 8/10 score reflects total milestone effort, not a single work item. Execution happens through its 5 child tasks (all complexity ≤5): Reusable chart component library, Dashboard data access & API layer, Dashboard layout & navigation shell, Filters & date-range controls, then Dashboard integration & end-to-end tests. Milestone is complete when all children are done.

tasks.name: CSV upload endpoint & file intake
tasks.details: Implement an endpoint/service that accepts customer CSV uploads, stores raw files in staging, handles size/encoding limits, and records upload metadata. Single responsibility: intake only.

tasks.name: CSV schema validation & error reporting
tasks.details: Validate uploaded CSVs against expected column schemas and types, collect row-level errors, and produce a clear validation report. Scope limited to validation logic and reporting.

tasks.name: Data cleansing & normalization
tasks.details: Implement deterministic cleansing: trim whitespace, normalize dates/currency/casing, handle nulls and duplicates. One focused transformation module.

tasks.name: Load cleansed data into analytics store
tasks.details: Persist cleansed CSV data into the analytics store (e.g., warehouse/DB), with idempotent upserts and load metadata. Scope: loading only, not querying.

tasks.name: Log ingestion from application log sources
tasks.details: Set up collection of application logs (file tailing/shipping) into a staging location with rotation/offset handling. Intake only.

tasks.name: Log parsing & structured extraction
tasks.details: Parse raw log lines into structured fields (timestamp, level, service, message, trace id) with robust handling of malformed lines.

tasks.name: Log aggregation & metrics computation
tasks.details: Compute time-bucketed metrics (error counts, request rates, latency percentiles) from parsed logs and store aggregates.

tasks.name: Error & anomaly detection rules
tasks.details: Implement rule-based detection of error spikes and anomalous patterns over aggregates, emitting alerts/metrics for the dashboard.

tasks.name: Reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Build a small set of reusable chart components (line, bar, pie/donut, KPI card) with a consistent props API and theming. Components only; no data fetching.

tasks.name: Dashboard data access & API layer
tasks.details: Expose query endpoints that serve processed CSV aggregates and log metrics to the frontend, including pagination and caching. No UI work.

tasks.name: Dashboard layout & navigation shell
tasks.details: Implement the dashboard page shell: grid layout, navigation between sections (Customer Data, Logs, Overview), and responsive breakpoints. Layout only.

tasks.name: Filters & date-range controls
tasks.details: Build reusable filter controls (date range, segment, service) and wire their state into a shared dashboard filter context.

tasks.name: Dashboard integration & end-to-end tests
tasks.details: Wire charts + filters to the data API on each dashboard page and add end-to-end tests covering load, filter changes, and data refresh.
